verdict.rationale: USCIS's own pages document a secure online filing system where you file forms and pay fees online through a myUSCIS account. However, online filing is scoped to a list of popular forms (N-400, I-90, I-130), and its own pages describe mail filing with G-1450/G-1650 payment for other cases, so not every core filing is shown to be completable online. Missing for 10: evidence that the full range of filings, including founder-relevant business or employment petitions, can be filed online, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end online submission.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: complete your form using our secure online filing system, avoid common mistakes, and pay your fees online.
